seo.title: KiBay Wine | Tropical Wine Crafted at Ocoa Bay
seo.description: KiBay Wine: An authentic expression of Caribbean terroir. Tropical wine crafted at Ocoa Bay with innovative winemaking techniques.

hero.subtitle: Tropical Wine Crafted at Ocoa Bay
hero.body: An expression of Caribbean terroir and innovative winemaking. Smooth, aromatic, and deeply rooted in the land of the Dominican Republic.

origin.heading: Rooted in Place
origin.intro: KiBay Wine is not just made in the Caribbean; it is of the Caribbean. It captures the essence of Ocoa Bay—the salinity of the sea air, the minerality of the soil, and the intensity of the tropical sun.
origin.body1: The Ocoa Bay region offers a unique microclimate for viticulture. The combination of dry weather, cool maritime breezes, and limestone-rich soils creates conditions that allow our fruits to develop complex flavor profiles unlike anywhere else in the world.
origin.body2: Our winemakers harness these natural gifts, employing sustainable farming practices that honor the land and ensure the longevity of our ecosystem.

flavor.heading: A Taste of the Caribbean
flavor.aromaBody: The nose is greeted with an intense bouquet of tropical fruits—ripe mango, passion fruit, and subtle citrus blossom notes. It is fragrant without being perfumed, inviting the drinker in.
flavor.bodyBody: Light, smooth, and refreshing. KiBay Wine features a delicate structure that highlights fruit purity over heavy tannins or oak. It finishes clean, with a lingering hint of minerality.
flavor.essenceBody: KiBay Wine captures the relaxed yet vibrant energy of the Dominican lifestyle. It is a wine that feels at home at a formal dinner as it does at a beachside gathering. It represents the harmony between land, sea, and fruit.

enjoy.heading: Moments Worth Savoring
enjoy.intro: Designed to complement the Caribbean climate and cuisine.

items.title: Serve Chilled
items.text: Best enjoyed between 8-10°C to accentuate its refreshing acidity.

items.title: Perfect Pairing
items.text: Complements fresh seafood, ceviche, mild cheeses, and light salads.

items.title: Sunset Ritual
items.text: The ideal companion for the golden hour, reflecting the warmth of the sun.

relationship.heading: Two Expressions, One Origin
relationship.body: Just like our Sparkling, KiBay Wine is born from the same dedication to organic quality and local sourcing. While the Sparkling celebrates effervescence and celebration, KiBay Wine offers a tranquil, contemplative experience of our terroir. Together, they represent the full spectrum of Ocoa Bay's potential.

closing.heading: Heritage & Innovation
closing.body: KiBay Wine stands at the intersection of Dominican agricultural heritage and modern viniculture. It is our invitation to the world to taste the Caribbean in a new, sophisticated way.
